design.scale_rationale: Ten broad human-activity Domains, five concrete Instances per Domain, and eight balanced Scenarios per Instance provide coverage and replication without defining Domains by cross-cutting Apps or resources.

domains.title: Education and School Life
domains.brief: Formal education and organized learning across courses, assignments, examinations, laboratories, school services, clubs, resources, schedules, and academic administration. Instances may vary by educational stage, program, institution, and student responsibilities.

domains.title: Work and Professional Life
domains.brief: Employment and professional activity across projects, meetings, deliverables, collaboration, workplace administration, training, clients, and career development. Instances may vary by occupation, organization, seniority, and work arrangement.

domains.title: Home and Household Life
domains.brief: Operating a home across routines, maintenance, utilities, supplies, shared responsibilities, service coordination, records, and household projects. Instances may vary by residence, tenure, household composition, and responsibilities.

domains.title: Family and Caregiving Life
domains.brief: Family coordination and practical caregiving across shared plans, dependents, appointments, celebrations, communication, responsibilities, and everyday support. Exclude diagnosis, treatment decisions, and other professional high-stakes advice.

domains.title: Health, Fitness, and Wellbeing
domains.brief: Everyday wellbeing across routines, fitness, accessibility, appointments, supplies, records, and following saved professional guidance. Exclude diagnosis, dosage, treatment selection, and emergency decisions.

domains.title: Travel and Mobility
domains.brief: Movement across commuting, local transportation, multi-stop travel, reservations, documents, itineraries, accessibility, packing, and disruptions. Instances may range from recurring mobility routines to major trips.

domains.title: Community and Civic Life
domains.brief: Participation in communities across volunteering, libraries, local programs, neighborhood activities, public services, memberships, shared resources, and routine civic administration. Exclude legal interpretation and political persuasion.

domains.title: Social and Cultural Life
domains.brief: Friendships and cultural participation across gatherings, celebrations, performances, exhibitions, groups, invitations, shared plans, and social commitments. Instances should center on sustained social or cultural activity rather than one event.

domains.title: Recreation, Sports, and Hobbies
domains.brief: Ongoing recreational activity across practice, equipment, clubs, competitions, outdoor activities, collections, workshops, and hobby communities. Instances may differ by activity while retaining several related workflows.

domains.title: Personal Projects and Life Planning
domains.brief: Self-directed goals and multi-step personal undertakings across planning, milestones, documents, resources, coordination, learning, and routine administration outside formal school or employment. Instances should form a coherent portfolio rather than miscellaneous errands.
